name: ACLED
methodology: Trained researchers code conflict events from local, regional, national, and international media. Peer-reviewed coding methodology.
coverage: Theater-specific country filters; global view uses a curated subset. Requires configured credentials; otherwise labelled demo.

name: NASA FIRMS
fullName: Fire Information for Resource Management System
methodology: VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite) satellite sensors detect thermal anomalies at 375m resolution.
coverage: Selected theater; global fetch split into continental boxes. Requires FIRMS key; empty unconfigured shell is not zero fires.

name: GDELT
fullName: Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone
methodology: Machine-translated news monitoring from 100+ languages. Tone analysis using sentiment algorithms.

name: EIA / Yahoo Finance
fullName: US Energy Information Administration (when EIA_API_KEY is set); otherwise Yahoo Finance futures chart endpoint
methodology: Official EIA Brent/WTI spot prices when an EIA key is configured. Without it: daily closes of Brent (BZ=F) and WTI (CL=F) front-month futures from Yahoo Finance's public chart endpoint — unofficial, no SLA. If both fail, a hand-typed Feb–Mar 2026 series is shown, badged CURATED with its end date.

name: USGS
methodology: Global seismograph network. Magnitude, depth, and location computed from multiple sensor stations.
coverage: Selected theater bounding box, or worldwide in Global view

name: Airplanes.live
methodology: Crowd-sourced ADS-B network; overlapping regional queries. OpenSky fallback and dated static snapshot when upstream fails. Heading vectors are modelled 3 min ahead, not observed future positions.
coverage: Global query set with theater filters; receiver coverage is partial

name: OpenSky Network
methodology: Anonymous or OAuth2 /states/all fallback. Provider credit limits depend on authentication; not every displayed flight is an OpenSky observation.
coverage: Global — theater bbox filter applied server-side

name: Intelligence RSS Feeds
url: Multiple (BBC, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, etc.)
methodology: Aggregated RSS feeds from 16+ vetted international news sources. Keyword-scored and source-weighted.

name: ReliefWeb
methodology: Humanitarian endpoint prefers UNHCR displacement statistics with ReliefWeb reports. Observation dates and actual payload source take precedence over this catalog.

name: Copernicus / Sentinel Hub
methodology: ESA Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery at 10m resolution. True color and NDVI processing via evalscripts.

name: NASA GIBS
methodology: Pre-rendered map tiles from NASA satellite products (VIIRS, MODIS, etc.). Public access, no credentials required.

name: Market Data
methodology: Real-time prices from multiple financial data providers via CORS proxy chain. Crypto from Binance WebSocket.
coverage: Commodities, indices, crypto, FX — war-relevant symbols

name: AISStream
methodology: AIS WebSocket reports; Pages collects a bounded window per request, not a permanent global stream. Dated snapshot fallback is explicitly stale.
coverage: Partial receiver/subscription coverage; not a census of ships worldwide

name: VesselFinder
methodology: VesselsList subscription endpoint for user-defined fleet (IMO/MMSI). Credit-based /vessels and area LiveData require paid plans — not used for global map.
coverage: Configured fleet only; not worldwide area LiveData. Subscription entitlement is provider-controlled.

name: Curated Intelligence
methodology: Legacy bundled references. Not currently revalidated or live; use dataset-specific dates and citations. Personnel roster is undated and marked unverified.
coverage: Conflict milestones, sanctions, nuclear facilities, key figures, actor networks, war costs, displacement
